subject: How to change the size of the histogram bin?

messages.author: 491fff0079fc57d6
messages.subject: How to change the size of the histogram bin?
parts:
Please explain the histogram that Rattle generates from a simple set {1,2,2,3,3,3,3,4,4,5,6} (see attached black and white chart).
Is it possible to change the size of the histogram bin in Rattle "Explore / Distribution / Histogram" so, for example, from the above set I could get a histogram as shown at colored chart (attached) .

messages.author: 51ea28fc190ac537
messages.subject: Re: How to change the size of the histogram bin?
parts:
Sure - I think you might have sampling turned on. On the Data tab, be sure to uncheck the Partition check box.

Regards,
Graham
